# Draft:Almighty Warlord Nation

Almighty Warlord Nation
The Almighty Warlord Nation(Warlords For Short,Abbreviated AWLN) Is A Orc Power Bandits Faction In Skyrim, Tamriel. Its Membership Is Estimated To Be Between 300 And 400. It Is A Founding Member Of The Outlaw Nation Multi-Faction Alliance.
